name: DateField
description:
A calendar day typed in the locale's order ("13/10/2026") or picked from a calendar. Any
separator works and two-digit years mean 20xx; the text is tidied on blur. Text that is
not a day (or is outside min/max) turns the box invalid and keeps what was typed.
signature: ({ value, defaultValue, onValueChange, locale, min, max, size, width, placeholder, disabled, readOnly, invalid, name, id, onBlur, className, ref, ...aria }: DateFieldProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only. Applied to the control box.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Invalid outside a Field. Text that is not a date marks the field invalid by itself.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale: the typed order ("dd/mm/yyyy" in en-AU), names, first weekday.

props.name: max
props.description: Upper value or visible-item limit, as specified by the type.

props.name: name
props.description: The component’s name or native form field name, as specified by its value type.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when blur occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with a valid day, or null when the field is emptied. Typing commits on blur or Enter.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The prompt shown while the value is empty. It does not replace the field’s label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displays the current value without allowing edits.

props.name: ref
props.description: Receives the underlying element for focus or measurement. React 19 accepts ref as a normal prop.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: value
props.description: A calendar day (`2026-10-13`), or null when empty.

props.name: width
props.description: Content width (R15.6). A date fits `short`… almost: the default is medium.
